_note: Owned by Member 5. One entry per SDG used in skills.json/roles.json. Add the specific sub-target and a one-line reason for every tag.

sdgs.name: Quality education
sdgs.reason: Builds relevant skills for decent jobs.

sdgs.name: Affordable and clean energy
sdgs.reason: Solar install, PV system design and battery storage skills directly grow the share of renewable energy in the energy mix.

sdgs.name: Decent work and economic growth
sdgs.reason: Supports productive employment as AI changes work.

sdgs.name: Industry, innovation and infrastructure
sdgs.reason: AI tools, RPA, data and manufacturing-technology skills upgrade the technological capabilities of industrial and service sectors and encourage innovation.

sdgs.name: Reduced inequalities
sdgs.reason: Responsible AI practices help ensure AI-driven decisions do not create discriminatory outcomes, supporting equal opportunity.

sdgs.name: Sustainable cities and communities
sdgs.reason: Energy monitoring and auditing skills reduce the environmental impact of buildings and infrastructure in cities.

sdgs.name: Responsible consumption and production
sdgs.reason: ESG reporting skills help companies integrate sustainability information into their reporting cycle.

sdgs.name: Climate action
sdgs.reason: Predictive maintenance and energy auditing skills build the institutional capacity needed for climate mitigation.

sdgs.name: Peace, justice and strong institutions
sdgs.reason: Responsible AI governance skills help build effective, accountable and transparent institutional use of AI systems.
